label: TOTAL_DAS Collect Flow
info: Collect only: Line DAS equipment payload subscriptions + Sensor DAS canonical leaf subscriptions.

label: TOTALDAS TimescaleDB Batch
info: Write canonical snapshot into TimescaleDB equipment_snapshot by 1-second or 30-row batched UPSERT. Includes Join, skip epoch/zero ts, in-batch dedupe by (ts, line_id, equipment_id), and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE.

label: TOTALDAS UDP Stream
info: Maintain latest 27-equipment cache from canonical.snapshot.out and send fixed-length binary UDP full snapshot every 1 second.

label: TOTAL_DAS Legacy NS2
info: Rebuild legacy ns2 nodes from canonical snapshot.

label: TOTALDAS Command Response DB
info: Write command latest response projection from canonical snapshot. Always upsert latest; insert event only when latest state changed.
